changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE TFPM_ADDR_ENRICH.VALIDATION_FEEDBACK ( FEEDBACK_ID NUMBER(19) GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, RESULT_ID NUMBER(19) NOT NULL, FIELD_NAME VARCHAR2(20 CHAR) NOT NULL, ORIGINAL_VALUE VARCHAR2(512 CHAR), CORRECTED_VALUE VARCHAR2(512 CHAR) NOT NULL, CORRECTED_BY VARCHAR2(64 CHAR) NOT NULL, CORRECTED_AT TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL, CORRECTION_REASON VARCHAR2(64 CHAR), COUNTRY_HINT CHAR(2), VERSION NUMBER(10) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_FEEDBACK PRIMARY KEY (FEEDBACK_ID, CORRECTED_AT), CONSTRAINT FK_FEEDBACK_RESULT FOREIGN KEY (RESULT_ID) REFERENCES TFPM_ADDR_ENRICH.STRUCTURING_RESULTS(RESULT_ID), CONSTRAINT CK_FB_FIELD CHECK (FIELD_NAME IN ('CTRY','TWN_NM','PST_CD','CTRY_SUB_DVSN','STRT_NM','BLDG_NB','BLDG_NM','ADR_LINE')) ) PARTITION BY RANGE (CORRECTED_AT) INTERVAL (NUMTODSINTERVAL(30, 'DAY')) (PARTITION P_INITIAL VALUES LESS THAN (TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'));

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE TFPM_ADDR_ENRICH.ACCURACY_SAMPLES ( SAMPLE_ID NUMBER(19) GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, RESULT_ID NUMBER(19) NOT NULL, COUNTRY_HINT CHAR(2) NOT NULL, CONFIDENCE_BUCKET VARCHAR2(8 CHAR) NOT NULL, SAMPLED_AT TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL, STATUS VARCHAR2(16 CHAR) DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL, REVIEWER VARCHAR2(64 CHAR), REVIEWED_AT TIMESTAMP(6), PER_FIELD_VERDICT CLOB CONSTRAINT CK_VERDICT_JSON CHECK (PER_FIELD_VERDICT IS JSON), NOTES VARCHAR2(2000 CHAR), VERSION NUMBER(10) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_SAMPLE PRIMARY KEY (SAMPLE_ID, SAMPLED_AT), CONSTRAINT FK_SAMPLE_RESULT FOREIGN KEY (RESULT_ID) REFERENCES TFPM_ADDR_ENRICH.STRUCTURING_RESULTS(RESULT_ID), CONSTRAINT CK_SAMPLE_STATUS CHECK (STATUS IN ('PENDING','IN_REVIEW','REVIEWED','DISCARDED')), CONSTRAINT CK_SAMPLE_BUCKET CHECK (CONFIDENCE_BUCKET IN ('HIGH','MID','LOW')) ) PARTITION BY RANGE (SAMPLED_AT) INTERVAL (NUMTODSINTERVAL(30, 'DAY')) (PARTITION P_INITIAL VALUES LESS THAN (TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'));
